info.name: ALS – MVP API contract (0.3.0)
info.description:
Collection générée depuis `openapi/openapi.yaml` (`npm run postman:build`). Ne pas modifier à la main.

1. Lancez `npm run mock:server` (ou `npm run mock:prism`) et choisissez l'environnement correspondant.
2. Chaque requête porte déjà son token (variables `token_*`), un `X-Correlation-Id` et, pour les opérations d'argent, un `Idempotency-Key` générés.
3. Pour rejouer toute la collection (Run collection), lancez d'abord **Réinitialiser** dans le dossier 0.

item.name: 4 · account-opening
item.description: Account opening with KYC – application, documents, phone verification, automatic checks, compliance decision

item.name: List account opening applications (back-office work queue)

header.description: Mock uniquement : force un scénario pour cette requête (ok, cbsDown, kmsDown, timeout, refused, unauthorized)

request.description:
Back-office list, newest first. The compliance work queue is
`?status=UNDER_REVIEW`. Roles: AGENT, SUPERVISOR, ADMIN, COMPLIANCE.

**Rôle utilisé :** COMPLIANCE (variable `{{token_compliance}}`).

item.name: Start an account opening application (draft)

header.description: Mock uniquement : force un scénario pour cette requête (ok, cbsDown, kmsDown, timeout, refused, unauthorized)

request.description:
- Channel `KIOSK`: self-service, **no token needed** (the prospect has
  no account yet). `kioskId` is required and the ACCOUNT_OPENING
  service must not be UNAVAILABLE on that kiosk (else `422`). The
  response carries an `applicationToken`, to send as
  `Authorization: Bearer <applicationToken>` on the next calls for
  this application only.
- Channel `BRANCH`: an AGENT or ADMIN token is required.

**Sans authentification.**

header.description: Mock uniquement : force un scénario pour cette requête (ok, cbsDown, kmsDown, timeout, refused, unauthorized)

request.description:
Allowed with the application token, or for AGENT, SUPERVISOR, ADMIN, COMPLIANCE.

**Rôle utilisé :** AGENT (variable `{{token_agent}}`).

item.name: Complete or correct a draft application (partial)

header.description: Mock uniquement : force un scénario pour cette requête (ok, cbsDown, kmsDown, timeout, refused, unauthorized)

request.description:
Only while `DRAFT` (else `409 APPLICATION_NOT_EDITABLE`). Fields of
`applicant` are merged one level deep: `idDocument` and `address`
are replaced as a whole. Changing `applicant.phone` resets
`phoneVerified`. Allowed with the application token, or for AGENT, ADMIN.

**Rôle utilisé :** AGENT (variable `{{token_agent}}`).

header.description: Mock uniquement : force un scénario pour cette requête (ok, cbsDown, kmsDown, timeout, refused, unauthorized)

request.description:

item.name: Delete a KYC document (only while DRAFT)

header.description: Mock uniquement : force un scénario pour cette requête (ok, cbsDown, kmsDown, timeout, refused, unauthorized)

item.name: Send a one-time code (OTP) by SMS to the applicant's phone

header.description: Mock uniquement : force un scénario pour cette requête (ok, cbsDown, kmsDown, timeout, refused, unauthorized)

request.description:
Only while `DRAFT`, and once `applicant.phone` is set (else
`422 PHONE_MISSING`). The code is valid 10 minutes, 3 attempts.
A new call sends a new code. The mock always sends `123456`.

**Rôle utilisé :** AGENT (variable `{{token_agent}}`).

item.name: Confirm the phone with the code received by SMS

header.description: Mock uniquement : force un scénario pour cette requête (ok, cbsDown, kmsDown, timeout, refused, unauthorized)

request.description:
`422` with `OTP_NOT_REQUESTED`, `OTP_EXPIRED`, `OTP_INVALID` or
`OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED` (a new code must then be requested).

**Rôle utilisé :** AGENT (variable `{{token_agent}}`).

item.name: Submit the application and run the KYC checks

header.description: Mock uniquement : force un scénario pour cette requête (ok, cbsDown, kmsDown, timeout, refused, unauthorized)

request.description:
Only while `DRAFT`. `422 APPLICATION_INCOMPLETE` with `details` when
a required field or document is missing, the phone is not verified
or the data processing consent is not given. Otherwise the KYC
checks run and decide the new status:
- a check `FAIL` → `REJECTED`;
- a check `REVIEW` or a `HIGH` risk → `UNDER_REVIEW` (compliance decides);
- else → `APPROVED`, and the account is opened (`account`).

**Rôle utilisé :** AGENT (variable `{{token_agent}}`).

item.name: Compliance decision on an application under review

header.description: Mock uniquement : force un scénario pour cette requête (ok, cbsDown, kmsDown, timeout, refused, unauthorized)

request.description:
Role COMPLIANCE. Only while `UNDER_REVIEW` (else `409`). `APPROVE`
opens the account; `REJECT` needs a `reasonCode`. The comment is
mandatory (audit trail).

**Rôle utilisé :** COMPLIANCE (variable `{{token_compliance}}`).

item.name: Cancel an application (DRAFT or UNDER_REVIEW)

header.description: Mock uniquement : force un scénario pour cette requête (ok, cbsDown, kmsDown, timeout, refused, unauthorized)

request.description:
Allowed with the application token, or for AGENT, ADMIN.

**Rôle utilisé :** AGENT (variable `{{token_agent}}`).
